scope: Cell heads accepted by the new-slide inference entry. The head is identified by the experiment_id stored in its checkpoint; the per-slide metadata records that identity and the checkpoint checksum so a prediction table can always be traced to the head that produced it.

v12_cls_sigma3_region_schwann_v1.role: released head fitted with the region-Schwann identity objective

heid_cls_sigma3.role: head refitted from this package with cell/configs/arm_cls_sigma3.json

v8_all5k_cls_sigma3_v1.role: reference head fitted with every labelled Schwann cell; produced the development-cohort clinical products and the Nerve evaluation replay

heid_cls_sigma3_all_schwann.role: reference head refitted from this package with cell/configs/arm_cls_sigma3_all_schwann.json
